scene: The golden voucher unlocks three distinct travel gates across the bustling market platform.
picture: Side-scrolling flat view along the platform. On the far left, a docked solar-sail junk awaits at an open slipway. The player stands left-of-centre holding her shiny token. In the centre, a ladder leads up toward a hanging brass cable pod. On the far right, a sleek neon bullet train waits with open doors.
shown: a wooden solar-sail junk tied at an open slipway on the far left
a hanging brass cable pod suspended by wires up high in the centre
